ocr_help.language: Select the language(s) present in the document. Multiple languages can be selected if the document contains mixed languages. Order matters: list the most prevalent language first for best accuracy.
ocr_help.dpi: Dots Per Inch - defines the resolution of the scanned image. Higher values (300-600) provide better accuracy but slower processing. Leave empty to use the document's native resolution. Typical values: 150 (draft), 300 (standard), 600 (high quality).
ocr_help.engine_mode:
OCR engine processing method:
• Original: Legacy engine, faster but less accurate
• LSTM: Neural network-based, more accurate for modern fonts
• Combined: Uses both engines for maximum accuracy (slower)
• Default: System-recommended setting (typically LSTM)
ocr_help.segmentation:
How the engine identifies text regions on the page:
• Default: Automatic detection (recommended for most documents)
• Single line/word/char: For images containing only one text element
• Column/Block modes: For specific layout types (newspapers, forms)
• Sparse text: For documents with scattered text elements
ocr_help.thresholding:
Image binarization method to convert grayscale to black-and-white:
• Otsu: Automatic threshold calculation (recommended for most cases)
• Leptonica: Alternative Otsu implementation
• Sauvola: Adaptive method, better for degraded documents with varying background
ocr_help.additional_params: Advanced Tesseract parameters in 'key=value' format. Example: 'tessedit_char_whitelist=0123456789' to recognize only digits. Consult Tesseract documentation for available options.
ocr_help.compress_pdf: Applies image compression to reduce PDF file size by 60-80% while preserving text accuracy. Recommended for most documents. Disable only if you need original image quality or are experiencing processing issues.
ocr_help.compression_target_dpi: Output resolution in Dots Per Inch. Lower values (50-100) create smaller files with acceptable quality for text. Higher values (150-300) preserve more detail but increase file size. Default: 100 DPI.
ocr_help.compression_bg_quality: JPEG quality for document background/images (1-100). Lower values create smaller files. Recommended: 30-50 for backgrounds. Text remains unaffected.
ocr_help.compression_fg_quality: JPEG quality for text/foreground layer (1-100). Higher values preserve text clarity. Recommended: 70-90 for readable text. Default: 80.
ocr_help.compression_flatten: When enabled, combines all layers into a single JPEG image. Creates simpler PDFs but less efficient compression. Disable for best compression (uses MRC - Mixed Raster Content with separate background and text layers).
ocr_help.output_formats:
Select one or more output formats:
• PDF with index: Searchable PDF with word-level coordinates
• PDF with text: Standard searchable PDF (recommended)
• Plain text: Text only, no formatting
• Page-delimited text: Text with page separators
• CSV: Word coordinates in spreadsheet format
• NER: Named entities (people, places, organizations)
• hOCR/ALTO: Structured formats with detailed layout information
